instruction: Walk out the bathroom door and make a left and head out into the hallway. Keep going straight under the archway towards the oven and the kitchen. Walk past the oven on your right and the kitchen island on your left and keep walking straight. You'll see a dining room table in the left, where there's also four windows, arched windows, with arched windows also above those windows. Walk towards the table. Take a right towards the black couch on your right on the hardwood floors. Once you get to the couch turn back around and then walk back towards the kitchen table. Once you're back at the table, you will see 6 chairs around it and 4 windows behind it. Walk to the first window from the right, next to the curtain. Once you're standing in front of that window, you're done.
